subject: [PATCH v3 13/14] selftests/nfsd: check that listener_set asks rpcbind once

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch adds tests to the NFS daemon (nfsd) selftest suite to ensure that listener_set requests only ask rpcbind once. The tests cover various scenarios, including stopping a listener after failure, silent set completion, and version set only. New functions are introduced to handle these cases, including RPCB_STUB_SILENT and version_set_only(). The patch aims to prevent multiple calls to rpcbind for each request, which would lead to inefficiencies in the system.
